scenarios.name: VT 1w4ts Novice S5
scenarios.description:
To change the walls, enable "Override Scenario Visuals" in the main settings tab.

Semi auto click timing with four stationary targets on a wall infront of the player. Each target takes 1 hit to eliminate and is worth 10 points. Sqrt Acc scoring applies.

scenarios.name: VT Aether Novice S5
scenarios.description:
To change the walls, enable "Override Scenario Visuals" in the main settings tab.

Full auto tracking with a series of three flying targets in a circular arena. Each target lasts 19 seconds and subsequent targets spawn at the same starting location after 1.5 seconds. Score is earned at a rate of 1 point per hit with a firerate of 100 per second.
